name: fork-microscope
description: Inspect saved Fork Microscope investigations and operate bounded workflows on your own connected compute.

interface.shortDescription: Explore model continuations and saved evidence
interface.longDescription: Read private saved investigations, compare outcome counts and continuations, and export portable evidence. New experiments require your configured model worker and execution authorization.
